fusions.name: Pond Slap
fusions.desc: A wet wing-slap that deals 12 damage, up to 1.4 times that at its full 5 tiles, knocks the target back 2.5 tiles and has a 60% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Silver Scatter
fusions.desc: Flicks 3 silvery scales in a spread, each dealing 3 damage. Your movement speed rises by 12% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slippery Bait
fusions.desc: Your dodge chance rises by 25% for 8 seconds. Up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles are drawn onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Greased Feathers
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 5% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
